g.text: USB-C AND POWER OR-ING (hardware design section 5).

g.desc: USB-C AND POWER OR-ING (hardware design section 5).

g.text: J5 is a USB 2.0 device port. R15 and R16, 5.1k on CC1 and CC2, mark the board as a device.

g.desc: J5 is a USB 2.0 device port. R15 and R16, 5.1k on CC1 and CC2, mark the board as a device.

g.text: U2 clamps D+, D- and VBUS: place it at J5. R97 and R98 are 0R, C52 and C53 are not fitted:

g.desc: U2 clamps D+, D- and VBUS: place it at J5. R97 and R98 are 0R, C52 and C53 are not fitted:

g.text: series and shunt footprints for EMC work, placed within a few millimetres of the module pins.

g.desc: series and shunt footprints for EMC work, placed within a few millimetres of the module pins.

g.text: D3 (from V_BUCK) and D4 (from VBUS) OR the two sources onto V5: about 4.95 V from 24 VAC,

g.desc: D3 (from V_BUCK) and D4 (from VBUS) OR the two sources onto V5: about 4.95 V from 24 VAC,

g.text: 4.1 to 4.9 V from USB. Neither source can feed the other. USB alone runs the logic, not the valves.

g.desc: 4.1 to 4.9 V from USB. Neither source can feed the other. USB alone runs the logic, not the valves.

g.text: U3 LDL1117S33R: 3V3 is 3.20 to 3.40 V. Load 162 mA typical, 498 mA peak. Give the tab copper.

g.desc: U3 LDL1117S33R: 3V3 is 3.20 to 3.40 V. Load 162 mA typical, 498 mA peak. Give the tab copper.

g.text: USB ground is circuit ground, which is one leg of the 24 VAC transformer: read section 5.3

g.desc: USB ground is circuit ground, which is one leg of the 24 VAC transformer: read section 5.3

g.text: and the safety page before connecting a mains-powered computer.

g.desc: and the safety page before connecting a mains-powered computer.
